entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.english: The electronic cargo information has been received
entries.note: The platform's order row: the shipment's data received, before Huiyu has the parcel.

entries.wording: 到达收货点 / Arrive at the delivery point
entries.note: Huiyu's receiving point in Shenzhen takes the parcel in, in Chinese and English in one row; the delivery point is where the shipper hands it over, not the recipient's.
